registry.historicalEvidence: Exploratory development. 2025 confirmation and 2026 results have already been inspected; neither is a new untouched test.

macro.vintageAvailability: Use from the close of the first NYSE session strictly after the vintage date; date-only vintages are not exact release timestamps.
macro.interactions: Each macro feature multiplied by each fixed sector indicator
macro.missingPolicy: No latest-revised substitution. Missing or stale inputs abstain; comparisons use identical rows and report coverage.

pretrained.historicalOrigins: first exchange session of each month, 2019-2024
pretrained.probabilityMapping: Linear interpolation of quantile CDF with tails clipped to 0.1/0.9; uncalibrated. At atoms, use the right-continuous CDF.
pretrained.variancePoint: Trapezoidal quantile integral with flat outer tails; an approximate mean, not the API's median point output
pretrained.contamination: Pretraining overlap with market history is unverified. Historical results are not clean out-of-sample evidence.

comparisonOrder: Market monthly versus market quarterly, separately for each task
Macro versus market at identical cadence on identical rows, separately for each task
Chronos versus market monthly and its baseline on identical monthly origins, separately for each task
registry.trialBudget: 12 tabular procedures, each with exactly 3 inner candidates; 3 frozen pretrained task mappings. Report every candidate and failed run. No adaptive expansion.
registry.promotion: none; reviewed future shadow launch required
registry.fineTuning: deferred until frozen-checkpoint comparison, compute review and a new registered protocol
